thread:
sara: Customer reports tool-calling path fails intermittently with schema validation error. They see a 500 and the response payload doesn't match the function schema. Request IDs: req_0a1b2c3d and req_0a1b2c4e. Need repro steps and debug bundle from the customer, they say it happens when they pass nested arrays to the tool.

josh: Thanks — can you paste the full curl we should use to reproduce? Also which model + tool name were they calling?

sara: Posted the curl they used (sanitized key). Model: rdlab/large-infer-1. Tool: price_lookup.

sara: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rdlab/large-infer-1","input":"","tool_calls":[{"name":"price_lookup","args":{"items":[[{\"sku\":\"ABC123\",\"qty\":1}]]}}],"stream":false}'
```

mike: quick note — the nested array around items looks suspicious. Could be JSONPath mapping in our response-to-schema check. Can you attach the exact response body (with request id) from the customer?

sara: They pasted this response (truncated):
```
{"request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","status":500,"error":"structured-output-validation","details":{"expected":"object","actual":"array","path":"$.tool_calls[0].result.items"}}
```

josh: Ok that's helpful. That "expected: object / actual: array" on path $.tool_calls[0].result.items matches schema where items should be an object with sku/qty, but they passed array-of-arrays earlier. Repro attempt in my sandbox replicates a validation error.

ops-bot: (auto) Collected runtime logs for req_0a1b2c3d and uploaded to https://internal.redwood/debug/1923456789/req_0a1b2c3d.log

repro-coordinator: Plan: 1) Ask customer for a minimal curl that reproduces (already have one) 2) Request their raw response body for both request IDs 3) Have eng-runtime reproduce with the exact payload and attach debug bundle. I'll coordinate and run a guided repro call.

sara: I asked customer to run the sanitized curl but to include the full response bodies and headers. Also asked them to run with their api_key replaced by a test key if they can.

josh: For eng-runtime, run this in staging to capture a debug bundle:
```
# enable debug bundle collection on the call
curl -X POST "https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke?debug_bundle=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '@payload.json' --trace-ascii debug_trace.txt
```
And include the server-side request id returned in the headers (X-Redwood-Request-Id).

mike: Also check KV cache hits — if a cached prefix returns a different shaped object that could cause the schema mismatch. Please include KV cache headers from the response: X-Cache-Status and X-KV-Variant.

sara: Customer provided second request id req_0a1b2c4e and attached a screenshot of headers: X-Redwood-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c4e, X-Cache-Status: HIT, X-KV-Variant: quantized-v2.

josh: That points to cached variant returning array-shaped items. Next steps: eng-runtime to reproduce with quantized-v2 variant and the exact nested-array payload. If repro, we'll add a validation transformer that coerces single-object arrays into object per schema as a short-term mitigation.

repro-coordinator: I'll assign this to @mike for runtime repro and @josh for schema patch PR. Sara, please get the two raw response bodies and run the staging debug bundle command and share links.

sara: Will do. Customer said they'll run the staging curl later today and send us the raw responses.

mike: I'll start a staging run now and report back with request ids and the debug bundle link.

josh: thx team. once we have the debug bundle and logs we can decide whether it's a runtime caching bug or a serializer mismatch.

sara: leaving a note to update customer: "We've reproduced a structured-output validation error tied to KV variant quantized-v2. We're collecting debug bundles and will follow up with a mitigation plan within 24 hours." :thumbsup:
